doc.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025

chapter: Time, Creative Music Studio and drumming
title: Lydia's benefit concert for CMS, not Creative Music Agency
summary: He denies founding a Creative Music Agency; Lydia organized a fundraising concert with prominent musicians.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: In the ‘70s am I correct that you and your wife created Creative Music Agency?
No. Okay. This is a misnomer then.

Yeah, no. She, you know we helped him you know when they were having some financial problems, Lydia and I — or Lydia arranged and shall we say fundraised the concert. And a lot of prominent musicians came to play there you know — Chick — he told Anthony Braxton, John Abercrombie, Colin Wolcott. So you know that’s where the contribution is — a contribution of giving like a free concert to raise money for CMS. But we were never on a board or anything like that. CMS had their own people doing that, managing the place.
